records.title: IUT ROVER SUMMIT
records.description: The crew brought the platform to the IUT Rover Summit and took the stage for its panel discussion — a national audience, an open bench, and questions from every direction.

records.title: IEEE SHOWCASE
records.description: The rover was presented to the IEEE Bangladesh community with its instrument deck and ground station opened up for inspection.

records.title: CAMPUS RETURN
records.description: United International University turned out for the team's return from the podium: garlands, a commemorative plaque, and several hundred students recording every step of it.

records.title: 3RD WORLDWIDE
records.description: UMRT took third place at the University Rover Challenge 2026 — the first Asian team on the podium in the competition's twenty-year history — and was recognised for the Best Autonomous System.

records.title: BEST AUTONOMY
records.description: The autonomous stack took the competition's Best Autonomous System recognition: navigating, identifying and reaching markers across open desert without an operator in the loop.

records.title: BEAR SUMMIT
records.description: A full exhibition build-out where the platform spent the weekend being touched, questioned, and photographed by a public that had never stood next to a rover.

records.title: SCIENCE CARNIVAL
records.description: UMRT represented United International University at the Udayan Science Carnival, driving the rover through a courtyard packed with school students.

records.title: TERRAIN TRIALS
records.description: Weeks of traverse testing on excavated ground: gradient limits, wheel slip, and recovery behaviour measured before the platform was cleared to ship.

records.title: INTEGRATION
records.description: The final integration window ran through the night — power, autonomy, comms, and the science payload brought onto one chassis for the first time.

records.title: URC TOP 5
records.description: After rigorous testing in harsh desert environments, the rover showcased advanced autonomous capability and secured a top-five finish.

records.title: INNOVATION
records.description: Recognized for real-time SLAM and obstacle avoidance that sharpened the rover's spatial awareness in uncertain terrain.

records.title: URC TOP 10
records.description: Mechanical reliability and precise manipulator control carried UMRT into the international top ten.

records.title: ERC POLAND
records.description: UMRT entered the European Rover Challenge and completed complex maintenance tasks under severe time pressure.

records.title: BEST ROOKIE
records.description: A robust suspension and determined debut earned the team the competition's Best Rookie distinction.

records.title: URC QUAL
records.description: The team qualified for the University Rover Challenge for the first time after thousands of hours of design and manufacturing.

records.title: PROTOTYPE
records.description: The first six-wheel rocker-bogie prototype proved the drive system across demanding local terrain.

records.title: FOUNDED
records.description: UMRT formed around a shared mission: push student engineering beyond the road and toward planetary exploration.
